name: HaloApp sources
description: The Halo app (motion graphics): the SwiftUI App scene and views in Sources/HaloApp, built from SuiteUI: the window, the Layer and Composition menus, the composition inspector (Pro density header, Composition rows and layer list), the Shape button and its ShapeToolOptions popover by the viewer, the viewer's status bar and timeline strip (scrub, select a layer, I and O set in and out points), the History panel (SuiteUI's HistoryPanel) with its History button by the transport and the window's autosave hooks, the New Composition sheet, the alert for a refused rename, and the hidden readouts the UI journeys read where XCUITest reads a value empty (#262).
